description: This Java class implements the InitializationDatabase interface to populate initial reference data such as languages, countries, zones, currencies, modules, and merchant store information in a sales management system.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the InitializationDatabase interface to populate initial reference data for the system.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the database with initial data, calling various create methods.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Populates the system with currency data based on predefined currency codes.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries and descriptions for supported locales.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Loads and creates zone data from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined language codes.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Creates a default merchant store with associated tax class.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Loads and creates integration modules from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createSubReferences
methods.description: Creates sub-reference data such as product types.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database is empty based on language count.
